scenes.say: Warehouse, lake, or lakehouse? Which one fits your data—and why do interviewers care?

scenes.label: Structured
scenes.sub: Stores clean, structured data for analytics.
scenes.say: A data warehouse stores structured data, optimized for analytics with fast SQL queries.

scenes.label: Raw
scenes.sub: Holds raw, unstructured or semi-structured files.
scenes.say: A data lake holds raw, unstructured or semi-structured files—think Parquet or JSON.

scenes.label: Hybrid
scenes.sub: Mixes warehouse analytics with lake flexibility.
scenes.say: A lakehouse blends both: analytics and ACID transactions on flexible, raw data.
Warehouses are fast but rigid. Lakes are flexible but messy. Lakehouses give you both analytics and flexibility, plus ACID reliability.

scenes.question: Can a data lake do ACID transactions?
scenes.right: Only lakehouses add ACID transactions to data lakes.
scenes.say: Watch out: not all lakes support ACID transactions. Only lakehouses add that reliability.
